problem: De novo IDP-targeted antibody design has not broken the interface-confidence ceiling (A-beta42 ipTM ~0.12-0.14 vs >0.3 aspirational binder target). The existing production path designs and scores against a single extracted ordered window and uses contact counting only for A-beta42.
technical_correction: AF2 multimer in this setup is single-sequence with templates disabled, so it returns a single interface PAE per (design, antigen) that does not vary across target conformations. The conformational ensemble therefore cannot be probed by per-conformation AF2 confidence; it enters only through (a) the design backbone (fixed-backbone design context) and (b) structure-based contact robustness across conformations. Per-conformation PAE is not a valid ensemble signal.

hypotheses.h1_ensemble_robust_contact: Contact robustness across K conformations (25th percentile heavy-atom contacts) ranks candidates more stably than single-conformation contact counting, rejecting candidates that contact only one conformation.
hypotheses.h2_disorder_guided_design: Injecting the per-residue disorder profile into BFN sampling (epitope_disorder_profile / disorder_guided, currently exploratory and unwired in production) plus ensemble design raises the achievable deployment-grade interface PAE relative to disorder-agnostic, single-conformation design.

protocol.design: CDR redesign via run_bfn_design (Complex mode), disorder-guided ON vs OFF (H2 factor)

validation.confidence: AF2 multimer interface PAE (single-sequence, 3 recycle) - one value per design
validation.ensemble_contact: heavy-atom contacts per conformation, reduced to 25th percentile (generalized beyond A-beta42 to alpha-synuclein and tau ensembles in data/non_abeta_idp)

protocol.confidence_policy: PAE only; ipTM and pLDDT are abstained per publication/candidate_interface_pae_deployment_v1.json

success_gates.g1_robust_pair_accuracy: robust-contact ranking separates designed vs composition-shuffle controls with pair accuracy >= 0.65 and cluster-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.5
success_gates.g2_ensemble_improvement: ensemble-robust (p25) contact ranking separates controls from designs more strongly than single-conformation contact ranking

claim_boundary: This is an exploratory R&D experiment. Success of H1/H2 does not establish a validated IDP binder; it only establishes whether ensemble-aware design and robust contact scoring improve the achievable interface-confidence signal. Wet-lab validation remains required for any binding claim.
